content: sd 0.5.15 performs ZERO id validation when loading a store: probed with the pinned fixture reference, records with ids 'seeds-fix003', 'nohyphen', 'seeds--', even uppercase/6-char suffixes all list and show. Strict read-side validation in a reimplementation (e.g. enforcing <project>-<hex4> on load) is a read-parity divergence breaking the 'our reader and sd agree on every record' contract — strictness belongs on the generation side only (ids we mint). Found when the qualitygate's dup-run-check fixture battery moved from sd to this repo's seeds binary and handcrafted fixture ids (seeds-fix003) failed SeedId::try_new (run 01M326WXXVST02QX4QKQQW9NE7, seed seeds-3791); fixed with SeedId::read (lenient, non-empty only) on the record read path.

description: Live probe 2026-09-27 (seeds HEAD 9be8a04 vs sd 0.5.15): undocumented divergences on global options — sd accepts -q/--quiet (suppresses list rendering, both argv positions), --verbose, --timing; seeds errors on --quiet/--verbose/--timing (unknown option/command), silently ignores -q after the command, and -v prints the banner while sd prints '0.5.15'. Not covered by differential.rs (matrix passes 3/3; global flags untested) and absent from README DEVIATIONS. Seeds' own help advertises -q/--quiet/--verbose/--timing, conflicting with help honesty (seeds-25b5).
resolution: Pending user decision: implement the global-option surface (-q/--quiet/--verbose/--timing + -v string parity) or amend help/DEVIATIONS; candidate seed, not yet filed.
